subject: Initial discovery: aligning AE/SE/eng windows for CloudTek
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rios <maya.rios@cloudtek.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial discovery: aligning AE/SE/eng windows for CloudTek

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for taking the call intro last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 45-minute initial discovery to align on your usage patterns, security constraints, and the engineering questions Paul will bring. Suggested attendees from our side: me (AE), Soojin (solutions engineer), and Lauren (customer success manager) — we can keep Lauren optional depending on agenda.

Proposed 45-min windows (PST):
- Tue 5/25 10:00–10:45
- Wed 5/26 14:00–14:45
- Fri 5/28 09:30–10:15

I attached a short agenda and a preliminary security questionnaire so your procurement/security folks can triage ahead of time. If those slots don't work, please send 2–3 times that do and we'll accommodate.

Agenda (high level):
- 10 min: introductions & success criteria
- 20 min: technical deep dive (traffic, latency SLOs, data flow) with Paul
- 10 min: security/compliance overview + next steps
- 5 min: mutual action items / timeline

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0137

Attachments: discovery_agenda.pdf (1 page), prelim_security_questionnaire.docx (fillable)
From: Maya Rios <maya.rios@cloudtek.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Chen <p.chen@cloudtek.com>, procurement@cloudtek.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: aligning AE/SE/eng windows for CloudTek

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — appreciate the agenda and the materials. Quick context: I'm Cloud Platform lead and I'll be the champion; Paul is our engineering lead and will run the technical portion. Procurement is cc'd for the questionnaire.

Of your proposed slots, Wed 5/26 14:00 PST works best for Paul and me. Procurement asked if we can confirm the security doc is editable — I'll push it to them today.

If Soojin is available for Wed 5/26 14:00, lock it in and send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Maya
Maya Rios
Cloud Platform Lead, CloudTek
maya.rios@cloudtek.com

Perfect — wed 5/26 14:00 PST is tentatively held.

Sooj, appreciate if you can confirm availability for 5/26 14:00. Lauren, copying you to flag an optional join for timeline/next-steps capture.

Maya — I'll send the calendar invite once Soojin confirms. In the meantime, procurement: the questionnaire is fillable; happy to hop on a short call to walk through any items after the discovery if useful.

— Karthik

Karthik / team —

I should be available on 5/26 14:00 PST. Quick note: I have a customer demo that day which may run long; can we provision a 60-min slot and plan to use first 45 for discovery and keep 15 for any wrap-ups? That will reduce the need to reschedule if technical discussion runs over.

Also adding a short pre-read: if Paul can drop a couple bullet points about the key traffic patterns (peak qps, payload sizes, whether data is tokenized client-side) before the meeting, I can prep targeted benchmarks.

Happy to confirm the calendar once we land on 60 min.

— Soojin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rios <maya.rios@cloudtek.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Paul Chen <p.chen@cloudtek.com>, procurement@cloudtek.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Final: discovery moved to 5/26 14:00–15:00 (60m) + calendar link

Thanks everyone — final confirmation: we've booked Wednesday 26 May, 14:00–15:00 PST (60 minutes) to give room for deep technical discussion. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudtek-discovery-20270526

Attachments included again for convenience: discovery_agenda.pdf, prelim_security_questionnaire.docx (fillable).

Pre-meeting asks:
- Paul: drop 2 bullets about traffic patterns to this thread before EOD Mon 5/24
- Procurement: any initial blockers from the questionnaire — flag in the doc or reply here
- Soojin: note any specific infra items you want to inspect (GPU requirement, on-prem connector, network egress patterns)

If anything changes I will update the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
